[SWS_FrTrcv_00437] ⌈In case of a fault during transceiver access, the initial-
ization process shall be restarted from the beginning.
It shall be retried un-
til the retry counter exceeds the number specified by FrTrcvRetryCountInInit.
If
the process doesn’t succeed, the function FrTrcv_Init shall raise a runtime error
FRTRCV_E_FR_NO_CONTROL_TRCV (see also [SWS_FrTrcv_00237]).⌋
